anomalies.expected: The specification describes the board as an ATtiny-driven fan controller (singular). A standard single-MCU fan controller should not have two different MCUs driving the same signal nets unless an alternate-footprint option is explicitly documented and one footprint is designated not populated.
anomalies.impact: If both footprints are populated, the two MCUs will drive the same nets, causing bus contention, unpredictable fan-control behavior, and programming conflicts. If only one MCU is intended, the extra MCU is a deviation from the intended single-ATtiny design.

parsed.summary: The design files show two ATtiny MCUs wired pin-for-pin, which conflicts with the intended single ATtiny-driven fan controller and would cause contention if both are assembled.
